answer: Ask the serge weaver how the work is proved: the serge weaver re-combs the tangled top with the fine combs, oiling the combs when they drag. The proof is Tenter yarn ribbon weaver madder warrant: a warrant yarn ribbon weavers show after ribbon loom trials. The knoll starts the proof, the vine holds the combs, the mesa signs off the top. Forgery takes 223 false tops and 223 false re-combings.
